name: Commerce
description: Functional e-commerce components. Crystal named none before, which left every store to reinvent a quantity stepper, a variant selector and a cart summary — and to re-solve availability, currency formatting and checkout validation each time. Payment is deliberately bounded: these components never handle raw card data, and defer to the host provider's own element.

components.name: Price
components.anatomy: A monetary amount with its currency and locale.
components.geometry: Tabular figures so a column of prices aligns.
components.semantics: The formatted value is the text content; currency is stated, not implied by a symbol alone.

components.name: Price range
components.anatomy: A from-to price, or a from price.
components.geometry: Matches price.
components.semantics: Reads as a sentence rather than two numbers with a dash.

components.name: Discount badge
components.anatomy: A reduction, as an amount or a percentage.
components.material: Haze fill with a status accent
components.geometry: Pill.
components.semantics: States what is reduced from what; a percentage alone is not a claim.

components.name: Quantity stepper
components.anatomy: A bounded integer with decrement and increment.
components.material: Resin shell with a Haze well
components.geometry: Pill; both controls reach 44px.
components.semantics: A spin button: the value is typable, and the bounds are announced when reached.
components.crystal: Materials, press recipe on each control

components.name: Variant selector
components.anatomy: Choice among product variants, with availability.
components.geometry: Options are pills; swatch variants are circles.
components.semantics: Unavailable options stay perceivable and say why; selection is label weight, never a check mark.
components.crystal: Option material, selection weight, unavailable treatment

components.name: Stock indicator
components.anatomy: Availability, with urgency where it applies.
components.geometry: Inline with the price or the action.
components.semantics: Words carry the state; status colour reinforces it.

components.name: Product card
components.anatomy: One product: media, name, price, rating and a primary action.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: The whole card is not a link; the name is, and the action is a button. One tab stop each.
components.crystal: Material, media aspect, action geometry, hover recipe

components.name: Product gallery
components.anatomy: Product media with thumbnails and zoom.
components.material: Haze thumbnails; Mirage scrim when enlarged
components.geometry: Thumbnails keep the content radius; the viewer is full-bleed within the scrim.
components.semantics: Arrow keys move between items with position announced; zoom is keyboard reachable.
components.crystal: Scrim and thumbnail materials, the transition into the viewer

components.name: Cart item
components.anatomy: One line of a basket: product, quantity, price, remove.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: Removal is announced and undoable; quantity changes announce the new subtotal.
components.crystal: Material, the update and remove motion

components.name: Cart summary
components.anatomy: Subtotal, discounts, shipping, tax and total.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: A description list, so each line is a labelled pair; the total is marked as such.
components.crystal: Material, figure alignment, the motion of a changing total
components.product: What the lines are and how they are computed

components.name: Coupon input
components.anatomy: A code field with apply, validation and applied state.
components.material: Haze well in a Resin shell
components.geometry: Field and action share one pill row.
components.semantics: Success and failure are announced; an applied code is removable.

components.name: Checkout steps
components.anatomy: Progress through a purchase.
components.geometry: Steps are pills; connectors are hairlines.
components.semantics: The current step is aria-current; completion is stated in words, and a check mark here means validated rather than selected.
components.crystal: Step materials, connector treatment, the advance motion

components.name: Payment method
components.anatomy: Choice among stored or new payment methods.
components.geometry: Options keep the content radius; the selected one carries label weight.
components.semantics: A radio group. Card fields are never reimplemented — the host supplies its provider element.
components.product: The provider, tokenisation, and PCI scope — this component never handles raw card data

components.name: Address form
components.anatomy: A locale-aware address, with the right fields per country.
components.geometry: Fields follow the input geometry.
components.semantics: Field order, labels and required-ness change by country; postcode validation is per-locale, not one regular expression.
components.product: Countries supported and their field rules

components.name: Order summary
components.anatomy: A completed or pending order, with items and totals.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: Status is a word; the status colour reinforces it.

components.name: Shipping selector
components.anatomy: Delivery options with price and estimate.
components.geometry: Options keep the content radius.
components.semantics: A radio group; each option states price and estimate together.

components.name: Delivery estimate
components.anatomy: When something will arrive.
components.geometry: Inline.
components.semantics: An absolute date, not only a relative phrase.

components.name: Wishlist button
components.anatomy: Adds or removes an item from a saved list.
components.geometry: Pill; 44px target.
components.semantics: A toggle with a pressed state and a name that says what it will do.

components.name: Review
components.anatomy: One review: rating, title, body, author and date.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: The rating is text as well as stars.

components.name: Rating summary
components.anatomy: Average rating with a distribution.
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: The average and the count are both stated; bars are labelled.

components.name: Filter panel
components.anatomy: Faceted filters with counts and clear-all.
components.geometry: Panel radius; controls are pills.
components.semantics: Applied filters are announced and individually removable; counts update politely.
components.crystal: Panel and group materials, the apply and clear motion

components.name: Sort select
components.anatomy: Ordering for a product list.
components.material: Haze well in a Resin shell
components.geometry: Pill.
components.semantics: A select whose current ordering is announced on change.

components.name: Compare table
components.anatomy: Products side by side by attribute.
components.geometry: Sticky first column and header; differences are marked, not only coloured.
components.semantics: A real table with row and column headers; differences are stated in text.
components.crystal: Table surface, sticky treatment, difference marking

components.name: Recently viewed
components.anatomy: A horizontal strip of previously seen products.
components.geometry: Scrolls within its own container; never the page.
components.semantics: A labelled list; the strip is keyboard scrollable.
components.crystal: Scroll surface, edge fade from the surrounding material
